steps.title: Initialize app metadata and package structure
steps.description: Configure app-meta.json and package identifiers for LockPlayTube.

steps.title: Configure permissions and Android Manifest
steps.description: Declare foreground service, internet, audio record, and wake lock permissions in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Design custom toolbar and WebView layout
steps.description: Construct standard layout structure with custom toolbar navigation, loading progress bar, and paywall container.

steps.title: Implement SQLite database for watch history
steps.description: Create HistoryDbHelper class to store, retrieve, and delete video watch history items.

steps.title: Build watch history Activity and adapter
steps.description: Implement HistoryActivity and HistoryAdapter with custom list items to display and manage watch history.

steps.title: Implement background audio playback service
steps.description: Set up BackgroundAudioService with MediaSession, notifications, and audio focus management.

steps.title: Implement paywall and access verification manager
steps.description: Create TrialPaywallManager for device ID generation, access verification, and dynamic UPI QR code fetching.

steps.title: Configure WebView settings and JavaScript interfaces
steps.description: Setup WebViewClient, WebChromeClient, and JavaScript bridges for playback state synchronization.

steps.title: Integrate native voice speech recognition
steps.description: Implement Android SpeechRecognizer and voice recognition callbacks to feed spoken queries directly into YouTube search.

steps.title: Inject background playback polyfills
steps.description: Inject custom JavaScript into WebView to override page visibility API and allow screen-off background play.

steps.title: Configure paywall lock screen overlay controls
steps.description: Wire up device ID copying, UPI ID copying, WhatsApp proof submission, and manual re-verification status checks.

steps.title: Building LockPlayTube
steps.description: Finalize and build the complete native Android application package.
